name: Shirafuji Nagi
source:
Likes: Food, games
Dislikes: Maths

Itsuki's classmate. She is a member of the PC Club because she loves playing games. Despite her cool and refined appearance, she is actually an idiotic tomboy with a black hole as her stomach. Nagi's worst subject is maths: when she tries doing some calculations, her head goes completely blank.
